detail.longDescription: A new Culver's opened up in my neighborhood, and to say I'm stoked is putting it mildly. Although I live in Colorado, I'm a Midwestern girl at heart. Each location offers a rotating flavor of the day, and I try to never miss the devil's food cake. I could sign up for the monthly newsletter, pick up a paper calendar in-store, or check the website every day, but in addition to being inefficient, none of those offer a real-time alert to get my devil's food cake.
